original: 痛っててて…
traducao: Ow, ow, ow, ow...

original: おい、大丈夫か？
traducao: Hey, you all right?

original: 随分派手にやりあったもんだな
traducao: You two really went at it, didn't you?

original: あの凶暴女……加減ってもんを\n知らねえのか！　\n……って
traducao: That violent woman... Does she not know\nhow to hold back!?\n...Ow-

original: あ痛てててててて
traducao: Ow, ow, ow, ow, ow, ow, ow!

original: ロニとナナリーって、ほんと仲がいいよな
traducao: You and Nanaly really are close, Loni.

original: 傍から見てると、結構\nお似合いの二人に見えるぜ
traducao: From where I stand, you two look\nlike quite a well-matched pair.

original: ばっ、馬鹿言うな！\n俺とあいつは、別に……
traducao: D-Don't talk crazy!\nMe and her aren't like that...

original: 照れるな照れるな。\nわかってるって
traducao: No need to get shy.\nI get it, I get it.

original: ふっ……そうだよなぁ？
traducao: Heh... Oh, really now?

original: お前も、アーチェと毎日\n朝から晩まで飽きる事なく\n痴話喧嘩してるもんなぁ？
traducao: Aren't you and Arche bickering like an old\nmarried couple from morning till night\nwithout ever getting tired of it?

original: ば……馬鹿言え！\nあいつはそんなんじゃ……
traducao: D-Don't be ridiculous!\nShe's not like that at all...

original: 大体、口を開けばむかつく事しか\n言わねえし、可愛げはねえ、料理は下手、\nおまけに能天気でバカで……
traducao: Every time she opens her mouth, it's to\nirritate me! She has no charm, can't\ncook, and is a total airheaded idiot...

original: でも、放っとけない……だろ？\n俺だって、同じだよ
traducao: Yet you still can't leave her be... right?\nI'm the exact same way.

original: 何かお互い、苦労するな？
traducao: Guess we both have it rough, huh?

original: ……だな
traducao: ...Yeah.

original: 世界の危機を救うべく現れた\n予言の勇者、ディセンダー
traducao: Appearing to deliver the world from peril:\nthe prophesied hero, the Descender.

original: かの人の歩む道は辛く険しい、だが\n踏み出したその一歩に迷いはない
traducao: Harsh and steep is this hero's path, yet\ntheir stepping feet know no hesitation.

original: なぜなら、勇者の傍らには\n厚い信頼を寄せる仲間の剣士と\nその親友である弓使いの姿があったのだ
traducao: For at the hero's side stands a trusted\nfellow swordsman... and that swordsman's\nclosest friend, the archer!

original: みなの力が合わさった時\n彼らの前に障害はない。\nそう、たとえそれが
traducao: When all their powers unite,\nno obstacle can bar their way.\nYes, even if that path should be...

original: どれ程困難な道であろうとも！
traducao: No matter how arduous it may prove!

original: あのさ……。\n前にも言った気がするんだけど
traducao: Hey...\nI think I mentioned this before, but...

original: その勝手にナレーション付けるの\nやめないか？
traducao: Could you stop adding\nunsolicited narrations to everything?

original: ああ、まぁ\nかたい事言うなよ
traducao: Come on, now,\ndon't be such a stiff.

original: もう趣味になってきてるよな……
traducao: It's practically become a hobby for you...

original: そうかあ？
traducao: You think so?

original: おい！　カイルは……カイルはどこだ！？\n無事なのか！！
traducao: Hey! Where is Kyle... Where is Kyle!?\nIs he all right!?

original: ロニさん、落ち着いて下さい。\nカイルさんなら、今治療中です
traducao: Please calm down, Loni.\nKyle is currently receiving treatment.

original: 命に別状はありませんから
traducao: His life is not in any danger.

original: 食堂にパナシーアボトルを\n常備しといて正解だったな……
traducao: Keeping Panacea Bottles stocked in the\ncafeteria was definitely the right call...

original: カイルの奴、例によって\n一口で撃沈したって話だぜ
traducao: Word is Kyle went down in a single bite,\njust like always.

original: ええ。\nあんなに震えてる患者さんを……\nわたし、初めて見ました
traducao: Yes.\nI've never seen a patient trembling\nso terribly before in my life...

original: よっぽど酷い料……いえ、\n食中毒だったんでしょう
traducao: It must have been quite awful cook-... er,\nfood poisoning, I mean.

original: 食中毒か……くそっ。\nかわいそうに、カイル……ッ！！
traducao: Food poisoning... Dammit.\nPoor Kyle...!!

original: 道をあけてくれ、急病人を搬送する！
traducao: Clear the way! Emergency patient coming!

original: すぐ医務室へ運んでやるからな。\nそれまで頑張れよ、カイル！！
traducao: We'll get you to the infirmary right now.\nHang in there until then, Kyle!!

original: カイル、しっかりしろ！
traducao: Kyle, pull yourself together!

original: 目を開けるんだ、カイル！\nカイル〜〜〜！！
traducao: Open your eyes, Kyle!\nKyyyyle~~!!

original: それにしても、あいつ……\nまさかそっち方向で腕を上げるとはな
traducao: Still, that girl... To think she would\nimprove her skills in THAT direction.

original: 次回から、アーチェさんには誰かとペアで\n料理当番に当たっていただけるよう\nアンジュさんにお願いしてみます
traducao: Starting next time, I'll ask Ange to pair\nArche with someone on kitchen duty\nto prevent this.

original: ああ、悪いな。\nそうしてくれると助かるぜ
traducao: Yeah, thanks.\nThat'd be a huge help.

original: カイル……お前の死は\n絶対無駄にしないからな……！
traducao: Kyle... I swear your death\nwon't be in vain...!

original: あの……カイルさん、\nまだ生きてます
traducao: Um... Kyle is\nstill alive.

original: リフィルって物知りだよなぁ
traducao: Raine really knows a whole lot, huh?

original: 「これぞ女教師！」って感じがして\nかっこいいよな
traducao: She has that true "schoolteacher" aura.\nPretty cool, if you ask me.

original: 先生はね、物知りなだけじゃなくて\nとっても行動力がある人なんだよ
traducao: The Professor isn't just knowledgeable,\nshe's also a woman of swift action!

original: ああ、各地の遺跡調査を\nしてるって話だろ？　\nすげえよな
traducao: Yeah, word is she investigates ruins\nall over the place, right?\nThat's pretty awesome.

original: うん、それもあるんだけど\nいらないって思った施設は\nどんどん爆破しちゃうんだよ
traducao: Yup, that too, but whenever she decides a\nfacility isn't needed anymore,\nshe just blows it right up!

original: 爆破！？
traducao: Blows it up!?

original: そだよ。\nだから先生はね、\nフエル爆弾って呼ばれてるんだ∀
traducao: Yup!\nThat's why the Professor is called\nthe HE Bomb!

original: フエル爆弾！？　\n通り名って事か？\nそりゃ、随分穏やかじゃねえ話だな……
traducao: The HE Bomb!?\nLike an alias?\nMan, that sounds pretty scary...

original: ……実はとんでもない奴なのか？\nリフィルって……
traducao: ...Is Raine actually someone dangerous?\nDeep down...?

original: うん。\n先生はすごい人だよ∀
traducao: Yup!\nThe Professor is truly amazing!

original: おい、クレス……。\nリフィルの事なんだが、どう思う？
traducao: Hey, Cress...\nWhat do you think of Raine?

original: どうって……。\n知的で、大人な女性だと思うけど
traducao: What do I think...? She seems like an\nintellectual, mature woman, but...

original: どうしたんだ？\nいきなりそんな話をするなんて
traducao: What's wrong?\nBringing this up so suddenly...

original: いや、実は聞いた話なんだが……
traducao: Well, from what I heard, anyway...

original: どうやらリフィルは\nかなり手練れの爆弾魔らしいんだ
traducao: Apparently Raine is a seasoned bomber\nwith serious skills.

original: 爆弾魔！？
traducao: A bomber!?

original: そんな、まさか……。\n何かの間違いだろう
traducao: That's impossible...\nIt must be some kind of mistake.

original: オレだってそう思ったさ！\nでも、実際にかなりの施設が爆破されて\n「フエル爆弾」って通り名まであるらしい
traducao: I thought so too! But she really blew up\na bunch of facilities, and she even has\nthe alias "HE Bomb" to prove it!

original: そんな……信じられないよ
traducao: That's... hard to believe.

original: ああ……
traducao: Yeah...

original: 綺麗な花にはトゲがある……ってヤツだな
traducao: Every rose has its thorns... as they say.

original: もうあんたなんか知らないっ！
traducao: I'm not talking to you anymore!

original: この変態！　すけべ！！\nベロベロベ〜〜〜だ！！
traducao: You pervert! Gross!!\nBleeeeh!!

original: ああ、それはこっちの台詞だ！
traducao: Yeah, that's my line!

original: また喧嘩をしていたの？
traducao: Fighting again?

original: シェリアか……びっくりさせるなよ。\nいつから見てたんだ？
traducao: Cheria... Don't scare me like that.\nHow long were you watching?

original: 見てたというか、聞こえちゃったのよ。\nあれだけ大きな声で喧嘩していれば……ね
traducao: Less watching, more overheard, really.\nWhen you shout at each other that loud...

original: ！　わ、悪ぃ……。\nそんなうるさくしてたつもりは\nなかったんだけどよ
traducao: ! M-My bad...\nI really didn't mean to make\nso much noise.

original: いいのよ、気にしないで。\nそれで、今度の原因は何だったの？
traducao: It's fine, don't worry about it.\nSo, what caused it this time?

original: ……ああ……大した事じゃねえよ
traducao: ...Ah, it was nothing major.

original: ったく、思い出しても腹が立つぜ……
traducao: Just thinking about it ticks me off...

original: でも、チェスターはアーチェと\nいつも一緒にいるわよね
traducao: Still, you and Arche are always together,\naren't you, Chester?

original: そんな事ないぜ。\n顔を合わせりゃ、喧嘩ばっかりだしよ
traducao: That's not true at all.\nWhenever we meet, all we do is fight.

original: ただ、あいつは……
traducao: It's just that she...

original: あいつは？
traducao: She...?

original: ……オレ達とは時間の流れが違う。\nだから……
traducao: ...Time flows differently for her than for\nus. That's why...

original: だから、一緒にいられる間は\n喧嘩をしても一緒にいたい？
traducao: So while you can still be together,\nyou want to stay close even if you fight?

original: ！？\nそんな事言ってねえ！
traducao: !?\nI never said that!

original: ううん、隠さなくてもわかるわ。\n相手を思う気持ちこそ\n一番素直に伝えられないものよね……
traducao: No, you don't have to hide it.\nTrue feelings of care are the hardest to\nexpress honestly, aren't they...?

original: う〜〜ん、恋ね……これこそ恋だわ！！
traducao: Mmm, love... This is truly love!!

original: 違うって！\n勝手に盛り上がるな！
traducao: I told you it's not!\nDon't get all excited on your own!

original: ねえチェスター。\nあんた、今ヒマでしょ？
traducao: Hey, Chester.\nYou're free right now, aren't you?

original: はぁ？　\nいきなり何だよ
traducao: Huh?\nWhat is it all of a sudden?

original: オレは今、弓の手入れで忙しいんだ。\n見りゃわかるだろうが
traducao: I'm busy maintaining my bow right now.\nYou can see that, can't you?

original: でもさ、それって\nヒマだからやってるんでしょ？
traducao: Yeah, but you're only doing that\nbecause you're bored, right?

original: お前なぁ……
traducao: Listen here, you...

original: いいからいいから、ちょっと\n心理テストに付き合いなさいよ
traducao: Come on, come on! Just take this quick\npersonality quiz with me!

original: 心理テストだぁ？
traducao: A personality quiz?

original: はい！　\nここにアーチェさんの、\nかわいいかわいい左手があります∀
traducao: Ta-da!\nRight here is Arche's super cute,\nadorable left hand!

original: 少しは人の話を聞けって……
traducao: Listen to other people for once...

original: じゃじゃーん。\nここでテストです！
traducao: Tadaaa!\nHere's the quiz!

original: この中で好きな指を選んで\n握って下さい∀
traducao: Pick your favorite finger here\nand squeeze it!

original: ちょ、ちょっと待て……。\n握るって、お前の指をか？
traducao: H-Hold on a second...\nSqueeze YOUR finger!?

original: そうだよ。\n当ったり前じゃん？
traducao: That's right!\nOf course mine!

original: ほら、早く〜！\nどれでもいいからさ
traducao: Come on, hurry up!\nAny finger is fine!

original: い、いや、それは、さすがに\n何て言うか……ちょっと……
traducao: N-No, I mean, doing that is kind of...\nyou know...

original: な〜に？\nいきなり赤くなったりして……
traducao: What's this?\nWhy are you suddenly blushing...?

original: あっ！　\nさてはまた\nエッチな事考えたんでしょ？
traducao: Wait!\nDon't tell me you were thinking\nsomething naughty just now!?

original: はぁ！？
traducao: What!?

original: イヤ〜、スケベ大魔王！\n誰か〜〜！\nスケベ、スケベがいるわよ〜〜！！
traducao: Eeww, you pervert archdemon!\nSomeone, help!\nThere's a gross pervert here!!

original: 誰がスケベだ！？\nこらアーチェ、待ちやがれ！！
traducao: Who's a pervert!?\nHey, Arche, get back here!!

original: んっ……、ん〜〜〜。\nんんっっ……！
traducao: Ahem... Hrmmm.\nHrkkk...!

original: どったの、チェスター？
traducao: What's the matter, Chester?

original: あ、わかった！\n今のアレでしょ、ボアの鳴き真似！
traducao: Oh, I know! You're imitating\na wild boar, right!?

original: してねぇよ！
traducao: I am not!

original: 喉の調子がな……、何か……、\nんんっっ……！
traducao: My throat's just acting up...\nHrkkk...!

original: はっは〜〜ん∀\nわかった。\n風邪引いたんでしょ〜？
traducao: Aha!\nI figured it out.\nYou caught a cold, didn't you~?

original: バカは引かないって言うのに\n変なの〜〜〜〜、ぷぷぷ
traducao: They say idiots never catch colds,\nso how weird is that, tee-hee!

original: 何だよ、あいつ……。\nからかいに来ただけかよ……
traducao: What is with her... Did she seriously\njust come over to mock me...?

original: もうちょっと、こう……\n他に言う事とか……する事が……
traducao: She could at least say or do\nsomething a bit more...

original: チ　ェ　ス　タ　ー　∀
traducao: C-h-e-s-t-e-r~!

original: な……、何だよ。\n戻ってきやがったのか？
traducao: W-What now?\nYou actually came back?

original: はい、コレ！
traducao: Here, take this!

original: コレって……
traducao: What is this...?

original: 決まってるじゃん！\n風邪によく効く\nスペシャルドリンクだよ∀
traducao: Isn't it obvious?\nIt's a special drink that works\nwonders on colds!

original: スペシャルドリンクって……\nお前……わざわざこれを……？
traducao: A special drink...?\nYou... went out of your way for this...?

original: これ飲んで、ゆっくり寝てれば\n風邪なんてイチコロだって！\nね？
traducao: Drink this and get some rest, and that\ncold will be gone in a flash!\nDeal?

original: （な、何だよ……アーチェの奴、\n　可愛いとこあんじゃねえか……）
traducao: (W-What the... Arche actually has\na thoughtful side to her...)

original: それにしても……\nこの臭いは……？
traducao: Still...\nwhat on earth is this smell...?

original: そんなの気にしない、気にしない♪\nよく効く薬程不味いっていうじゃん？\nささ、グッと一息でいっちゃって
traducao: Never mind that, don't worry about it!\nGood medicine always tastes bitter!\nDown the hatch in one gulp!

original: あ、ああ……
traducao: A-All right...

original: ん……、ん……、ん……。\nぷはー
traducao: Gulp... Gulp... Gulp...\nPffhh-!

original: どうどう？　効くでしょ？
traducao: Well, well? Working already, right?

original: 卵、にんにく、牛乳、トカゲの尻尾、\nスッポンの血と、その他諸々\nた〜〜っぷり入れてみましたぁ∀
traducao: Eggs, garlic, milk, lizard tails,\nturtle blood, and lots of other stuff!\nI put a whole bunch in!

original: ありゃ。\nもう寝ちゃったの？
traducao: Oh, my.\nAsleep already?

original: うっふふ〜、さっすが\nコウカテキメンなんだからぁ♪
traducao: Ufufu, I knew it!\nInstant results, just like I promised!

original: おい、リッド！\nどうして今日の授業をサボったんだ
traducao: Hey, Reid!\nWhy did you skip class today!?

original: いいじゃねえか、一回くらい。\nけちけちすんなよ
traducao: Come on, it was just once.\nDon't be so stingy.

original: けちとかそういう問題じゃないだろう！\nお前はどうしてそう考え無しなんだ
traducao: This isn't about being stingy!\nWhy are you always so thoughtless!?

original: まぁまぁ、そうカッカすんなよ。\nもう済んだ事なんだろ？
traducao: Now, now, don't get so worked up.\nIt's already over, right?

original: リッドだって反省してるさ。\nなぁ？
traducao: I'm sure Reid learned his lesson.\nRight?

original: チェスターには聞いていない！
traducao: I wasn't asking you, Chester!

original: 大体二人とも、明けても暮れても\n狩りばっかりじゃないか。\n一体、将来設計はどうなっているんだ！
traducao: Besides, all both of you ever do is hunt\nfrom dawn to dusk! What on earth are your\nplans for the future!?

original: 何だよ。\n狩りをする事の\n何がいけないってんだ？
traducao: What's that supposed to mean?\nWhat's so wrong with\ngoing hunting!?

original: 学問で教養を身に付けなければ\n社会に出て恥をかく
traducao: If you don't acquire knowledge through\nstudies, you'll be a disgrace to society!

original: 今から頭を使っておかないと、\n後退するのは\n前髪だけじゃ済まなくなるぞ
traducao: If you don't start using your head now,\nyour hairline won't be the only thing\nthat's receding!

original: おい！　\n何でそこで\n前髪の話になるんだよ！？
traducao: Hey!\nWhy did you have to bring my hairline\ninto this!?

original: まぁまぁ、二人とも、落ち着けって。\nもう済んだ事じゃないか。\nなぁ？
traducao: Now, now, you two, calm down.\nWhat's done is done, isn't it?\nRight?

original: お前が言うな！！
traducao: You don't get to say that!!

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n
